name: KiCad
tagline: An EDA suite for schematic and circuit board design
blurb: Design circuit boards end to end, from schematic capture to Gerbers for the fab house.
description: KiCad is a free and open-source electronics design automation (EDA) suite. It features schematic capture, integrated circuit simulation, printed circuit board (PCB) layout, 3D rendering, and plotting/data export to numerous formats. KiCad also includes a high-quality component library featuring thousands of symbols, footprints, and 3D models. KiCad has minimal system requirements and runs on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distro, sandboxed and always up to date.

install.label: winget
install.note: Built into Windows 10 and 11 — no download page needed.

install.label: Homebrew
install.note: Or plain `brew install kicad` for the command-line build if the cask is missing.

install.label: Build from source
install.note: For contributors and people whose distro has no package yet.

summary: An EDA suite for schematic and circuit board design
